title: Manipur Designer Gaikhuanlung Gangmei Nominated for Vogue Stylist of the Year 2026
summary: Manipur fashion designer Gaikhuanlung Gangmei from Chiuluan village, Tamenglong, is reportedly nominated for Vogue Stylist of the Year 2026 and invited as a jury member for Vogue Forces of Fashion in Mumbai.
body:
TAMENGLONG: Fashion designer Gaikhuanlung Gangmei, from Chiuluan village in Manipur’s Tamenglong district, has reportedly been nominated for the Stylist of the Year 2026 category at the upcoming Vogue Forces of Fashion event.

Gangmei has also reportedly received an invitation from Vogue India to serve as a jury member for the fifth edition of Vogue Forces of Fashion, scheduled to take place on November 18, 2026, in Mumbai.

The reported nomination and jury invitation mark a notable moment for Manipur’s fashion and creative community, bringing attention to a designer from a village in Tamenglong district on a prominent national fashion platform.

Vogue Forces of Fashion brings together personalities from the fashion industry to recognise creative work and discuss developments in style, design and fashion culture. Gangmei’s reported association with the 2026 edition places a spotlight on the growing presence of talent from Northeast India in the wider fashion industry.

For Tamenglong district and Manipur, the development represents an opportunity to highlight the region’s creative talent beyond its geographical boundaries. It also draws attention to the contributions of designers from the Northeast to India's evolving fashion landscape.

Further details about Gangmei’s design work, professional journey and the final award results are awaited.
author: Mirror Lilong Desk
